title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes
tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

faults.what: Only two finished images are supplied; the requested square 1:1 version is missing.
The supplied portrait and landscape canvases are close to, but not exactly, the requested 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.

judge.summary: Two attractive, consistent coffee ads contain the correct copy, but the required square version is missing.

must_haves.item: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
must_haves.why: Only portrait and landscape images are supplied, with no square image; their aspect ratios also differ slightly from the specified ratios.

must_haves.item: All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
must_haves.why: Both supplied images clearly feature a steaming dark-green coffee cup and a cream-and-dark-green palette, but the third image is absent.

must_haves.item: Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
must_haves.why: Both supplied images contain all three specified text strings, correctly spelled and punctuated.

must_haves.item: The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
must_haves.why: The two supplied images convincingly share the same cup, serif brand typography, palette and curved corner accents, but a third campaign image is not supplied.

must_haves.item: Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.
must_haves.why: Both visible layouts are deliberately rearranged for their canvases, with intact copy, naturally proportioned cups and no obvious padding workaround.
